record.title: Normality of smooth lattice polytopes
record.statement: Is every smooth lattice polytope normal? For a $d$-dimensional lattice polytope $P$, “smooth” means that the normal fan of $P$ consists of unimodular cones, while “normal” means that every lattice point in $kP$ is the sum of $k$ lattice points in $P$ for every $k\in\mathbb{Z}_{\ge 1}$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/39](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1595), page 28. Canonicalized from 3 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Conjecture 2: Remainder estimates for Liouville tori
record.statement:
Let $M$ be a torus with a Liouville metric. Then
\[
R(\lambda)=O\!\left(\lambda^{\frac12+\varepsilon}\right),\qquad R_x(\lambda)=O\!\left(\lambda^{\frac12+\varepsilon}\right),\qquad N_{x,y}(\lambda)=O\!\left(\lambda^{\frac12+\varepsilon}\right),
\]
for any $\varepsilon>0$ and for all $x\ne y\in M$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/41](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1597), page 6. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Decay of linear waves on Schwarzschild spacetime
record.statement: Let $(M,g)$ be Schwarzschild, let $S$ be an arbitrary Cauchy surface for $(M,g)$, and let $\\phi$ be the unique solution of the wave equation $\Box_g\phi=0$ on $(M,g)$ with sufficiently regular, compactly supported initial data prescribed on $S$. No symmetry is assumed on $\\phi$. Understand the decay properties of $\\phi$ in $R=J^{+}(\mathcal I^{-}_{A})\cap J^{-}(\mathcal I^{+}_{A})$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/41](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1597), page 23. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Attainment of the one-dimensional sharp Strichartz constant
record.statement:
For the one-dimensional Strichartz inequality
\[
\|u\|_{L^6_{t,x}(\mathbb{R}\times\mathbb{R})}\le S\,\|u_0\|_{L^2(\mathbb{R})},
\]
the best constant \(S>0\) is attained. The report further states that
\[
S=12^{-1/12},
\]
and that a corresponding minimizer/maximizer is \(u_*(x)=e^{-|x|^2}\), together with all its images under the symmetry group.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/44](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1727), page 21. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Global well-posedness for the one-dimensional defocusing quintic NLS at and below the energy regularity
record.statement:
For the defocusing quintic nonlinear Schrödinger Cauchy problem
\[
 i\partial_t u+\Delta u=|u|^4u,\qquad u(x,0)=u_0(x),\qquad x\in\mathbb R,
\]
is the problem globally well-posed in time for every initial datum in the Sobolev spaces \(H^s(\mathbb R)\) with \(s\ge 0\) for which the local theory is valid?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/44](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1727), page 25. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Examples attaining the lower bound for the \b6-order
record.statement: For every prime $p$, do there exist a field $k$ of characteristic $p$, a finite group $G$, and a nonzero Tate cohomology class $[\zeta]\in \widehat{H}^{n}(G,k)$ of even degree $n$, represented by a map $\zeta:\Omega^{n}k\to k$, such that $\zeta\text{-ord}(k/\zeta)=p-2$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/45](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1728), page 37. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Weak limiting behavior of cuts needed to isolate the root of a random recursive tree
record.statement:
Let $T_n$ be a uniformly distributed random recursive tree with $n$ vertices, and let $X_n$ be the number of random edge cuts needed to isolate its root. Then, as $n\to\infty$, $\frac{\log^2 n}{n}X_n-\log n-\log\log n\xrightarrow{d}X$, where $X$ is a $1$-stable random variable with characteristic function
\[
\mathbb{E}(e^{itX})=e^{it\log|t|-\frac{\pi}{2}|t|},\qquad t\in\mathbb{R}.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/46](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1729), page 9. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Generic nefness and pseudo-effectivity of the canonical bundle
record.statement: Let $X$ be a projective manifold of dimension $n$. A line bundle $L$ on $X$ is generically nef if $L\cdot H_1\cdots H_{n-1}\ge 0$ for all ample line bundles $H_1,\ldots,H_{n-1}$. Suppose $K_X$ is generically nef. Is $K_X$ pseudo-effective?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/47](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1730), page 38. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Dolbeault cohomology of nilmanifolds with left-invariant complex structure
record.statement: For every nilmanifold $M=\Gamma\backslash G$ with left-invariant complex structure $J$, can the Dolbeault cohomology $H^{p,q}(M,J)$, for all bidegrees $(p,q)$, be calculated using left-invariant differential forms?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/47](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1730), page 50. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Small deformations of nilmanifolds with left-invariant complex structure
record.statement: For every nilmanifold $M=\Gamma\backslash G$ with a left-invariant complex structure $J$, are all sufficiently small deformations of $(M,J)$ again nilmanifolds with left-invariant complex structures?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/47](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1730), page 50. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Nonvanishing critical Voronoi rectangle-crossing probability
record.statement: In planar Voronoi percolation at the critical parameter $p=1/2$, let $h(\rho,s)$ be the probability that there is a black path crossing the rectangle $[0,\rho s]\times[0,s]$ horizontally. For every $\rho>1$, $$\limsup_{s\to\infty} h(\rho,s)>0.$$

record.title: RSW-type a priori crossing bound for anisotropic critical percolation
record.statement: For bond percolation on the square lattice with horizontal and vertical edge-open probabilities $p_h$ and $p_v$, respectively, satisfying $p_h+p_v=1$, does there exist a constant $c>0$ such that $\mathbb{P}(H(n,n))\ge c$ for every $n$, where $H(a,b)$ is the event that $[0,a]\times[0,b]$ has an open horizontal crossing?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/48](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1731), page 39. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Relation between an overpartition rank-difference function and Hurwitz class numbers
record.statement:
Theorem 3 ([5]) states that

$$f(-q)=-16H(q)-\frac{1}{3}\Theta^3(z).$$

Here the report defines $f(q)=\sum_n\alpha(n)q^n=\sum_n(p_e(n)-p_o(n))q^n$ using the even- and odd-rank overpartition counts, and $H(q)=-\frac{1}{12}+\sum_{n\ge1\atop n\equiv0,3\pmod4}H(-n)q^n$ using Hurwitz class numbers.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/51](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1734), page 13. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Theory of the tilt-angle phenomenon for non-Newtonian liquids
record.statement: “There is until now no satisfactory theory to explain the tilt angle phenomenon for non-Newtonian liquids.” Here, the tilt angle is the angle formed by the long axis of symmetry of a falling cylinder or ellipsoid with the horizontal; experimentally, it may range from $0^\circ$ to $90^\circ$ depending on the particle and liquid properties.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/53](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1736), page 19. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Normalizer property for groups with finite normal subgroups satisfying NP
record.statement:
The normalizer problem (NP) for a group $G$ asks whether the normalizer of $G$ in the unit group of $
\mathbb{Z}G$ consists only of the obvious units, namely the subgroup generated by $G$ and the central units of $
\mathbb{Z}G$. If (NP) holds for every finite normal subgroup of $G$, does (NP) hold for $G$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/55](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1738), page 25. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Derived-series subgroups from commutator powers of augmentation ideals
record.statement:
Let $G$ be a free group. For a commutative ring $R$, let $\Delta(G)=\Delta_R(G)$ denote the augmentation ideal of $RG$, set $\delta_1(RG)=[\Delta(G),\Delta(G)]_{RG}$, and define $\delta_{n+1}(RG)=[\delta_n(RG),\delta_n(RG)]_{RG}$ for all $n\in\mathbb N$. If $G^{[n]}$ denotes the $n$-th term of the derived series of $G$, is it true that
$$
G\cap\bigl(1+\delta_n(\mathbb ZG)\bigr)=G^{[n]}?
$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/55](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1738), page 29. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Shellability of the space of tropically collinear points
record.statement: Develin conjectured that the tropical variety $T_{d,n}$ of the determinantal ideal generated by the $3\times3$ minors of a $d\times n$ matrix is shellable for all $d$ and $n$. The report states that this conjecture is proved.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/57](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1740), page 42. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Maximality of the real Zeuthen problem for two lines
record.statement: For every integer $d\ge 2$, does there exist a configuration $C$ of $2$ real lines and $d(d+3)/2-2$ real points such that all degree-$d$ curves passing through the points and tangent to the lines are real, equivalently $$N_d^{\mathbb{R}}(2,C)=N_d(2)?$$ The report answers this affirmatively.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/57](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1740), page 53. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Independence numbers of arbitrary powers of odd cycles
record.statement: The problem of determining the independence numbers of arbitrary powers of odd cycles remains widely open.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/01](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1782), page 9. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Kalai’s Conjecture A for centrally symmetric polytopes
record.statement:
For every centrally symmetric convex polytope $P$ of dimension $d$, with $f_i(P)$ denoting its number of $i$-dimensional faces, one has
$$
\sum_{i=0}^{d} f_i(P)\ge 3^d.
$$
The report states that this conjecture is open for $d\ge 5$ (and holds for $d\le 4$).
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/01](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1782), page 67. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Kalai’s 3^d-conjecture for centrally symmetric polytopes
record.statement: For every centrally symmetric convex $d$-polytope $P$ with $d\ge 5$, the total number of nonempty faces satisfies $\displaystyle\sum_{i=0}^{d} f_i(P)\ge 3^d$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/01](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1782), page 69. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Question 1: Collapse-forcing-invariant models of ZFC
record.statement: Does there exist a model $N$ of ZFC such that, for every cardinal $\\lambda$ of $N$ and every generic subset $H$ of $\\operatorname{Col}(\\omega,\\lambda)$, one has $N[H] \\equiv N$? Here $\\operatorname{Col}(\\omega,\\lambda)$ is the forcing to collapse $\\lambda$ onto $\\omega$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/02](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1783), page 21. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Higher-level separation of projective measurability and the Baire property
record.statement: Can we prove a variant of Theorem 6, where the set without the Baire property is a $\[1m\Delta^1_{k+1}\u001b[0m$ set, and we have, in addition, the Baire property for all $\[1m\Sigma^1_k\u001b[0m$ sets, $k\ge 3$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/02](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1783), page 28. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Dimension of the p-rank-zero locus in the Siegel moduli space with Iwahori level structure
record.statement:
For the Siegel moduli space $\mathcal A_{g,I}$ with Iwahori level structure at $p$, the dimension of its $p$-rank-$0$ locus is conjectured to be
$$\left\lfloor\frac{g^2}{2}\right\rfloor$$
for every integer $g\ge 1.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/05](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1786), page 43. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Characterizing bounded universality for self-maps of non-simply connected domains
record.statement: Characterize, for a non-simply connected planar domain \(\Omega\), those sequences \((\phi_n)\) of self-maps of \(\Omega\) for which there exists a \(B\)-universal function, where \(B=\{f\in H^\infty(\Omega):\sup_{z\in\Omega}|f(z)|\le 1\}\) and \(f\in B\) is \(B\)-universal for \((\phi_n)\) when \(\{f\circ\phi_n:n\in\mathbb N\}\) is locally uniformly dense in \(B\).
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/06](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1787), page 36. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Global attraction of finite-energy solutions to the solitary-wave set
record.statement: A natural hypothesis is that the set of all solitary waves forms a global attractor for all finite-energy solutions.

record.title: Massless-photon and point-charge limit of the nonrelativistic QED g-factor formula
record.statement: Does (14) have a finite limit when $m_{\mathrm{ph}}\to 0$ and $\widehat{\varphi}(k)\to (2\pi)^{-3/2}$?

record.title: Local injectivity of the Carmichael \-function
record.statement: For every positive integer $m$, there is an integer $n\ne m$ such that $\lambda(n)=\lambda(m)$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/14](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1795), page 20. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Conjectured optimal order of the primitive of Hardy’s function
record.statement: Let $Z(t)=\chi^{-1/2}(\tfrac12+it)\zeta(\tfrac12+it)$ be Hardy’s function and let $F(T)=\int_0^T Z(t)\,dt$. Ivić conjectured that the estimate $F(T)\ll T^{1/4+\varepsilon}$ for every fixed $\varepsilon>0$ is close to being best possible.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/14](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1795), page 41. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Almost-prime solutions to ternary quadratic equations
record.statement: Let $g(x_1,x_2,x_3)$ be an indefinite anisotropic quadratic form with determinant $d(g)$, and let $t\ne 0$ be an integer such that $d(g)t$ is square-free. The reported result states that the equation $g(x_1,x_2,x_3)=t$ has infinitely many solutions for which the product $x_1x_2x_3$ has at most $26$ prime divisors. Under Selberg’s eigenvalue conjecture, the bound $26$ can be reduced to $22$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/14](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1795), page 44. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Positive density of prescribed digit sums of squares
record.statement:
Let $q\ge 2$ be an integer, and write $\sigma(n)$ for the sum of the base-$q$ digits of $n$. For every integer $m\ge 2$ with $(m,q-1)=1$, there exist constants $C(q,m)>0$ and $x_0(q,m)\ge 1$ such that, for every $a\in\mathbb Z$ and every $x\ge x_0(q,m)$, 
$$
\#\{n\le x:\ \sigma(n^2)\equiv a\pmod m\}\ge C(q,m)x.
$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/14](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1795), page 56. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Maximum antichain size in the divisor poset of an integer
record.statement: Let $p_1,\ldots,p_N$ be distinct primes and let $M=p_1^{k_1}\cdots p_N^{k_N}$, where $k_i\ge 1$. Identify the set $D$ of divisors of $M$ with $\prod_{i=1}^N\{0,1,\ldots,k_i\}$, ordered by divisibility (equivalently, coordinatewise order). What is the maximal size of a subset $A\subset D$ such that, for every distinct $r,r'\in A$, neither $r\mid r'$ nor $r'\mid r$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/16](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1961), page 10. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Critical almost Mathieu spectrum Hausdorff-dimension conjecture
record.statement:
For every $\[?1m\alpha\u001b[0m \in \mathbb{R}\setminus\mathbb{Q}$, does the critical almost Mathieu spectrum satisfy
$$
\dim_H\bigl(S(\alpha,2)\bigr)<\frac12?
$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/16](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1961), page 28. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Uniqueness of two Majorana representations of $A_5$
record.statement: The alternating group $A_5$ of degree five possesses exactly two Majorana representations, of dimensions $26$ and $21$, corresponding respectively to $(2A,3A,5A)$- and $(2A,3C,5A)$-subgroups in the Monster that are isomorphic to $A_5$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/20](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1965), page 6. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Sylow-subgroup characterization of the soluble radical
record.statement: Let $G$ be a finite group, let $p$ be a prime, and let $P\in\operatorname{Syl}_p(G)$. Then $P\subseteq\operatorname{sol}(G)$ if and only if $\langle P,g\rangle$ is soluble for all $g\in G$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/20](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1965), page 11. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Babai’s diameter conjecture for finite non-abelian simple groups
record.statement:
For every non-abelian finite simple group $G$ and every generating set $A$ of $G$, there exist absolute constants $c$ and an implied constant such that
\[
\operatorname{diam}(\Gamma(G,A)) \ll (\log |G|)^c,
\]
where $|G|$ is the number of elements of $G$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/20](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1965), page 26. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Does a codistance on a 2-spherical building imply a twinning?
record.statement: For every 2-spherical building $\mathcal B$, does the existence of a codistance on $\mathcal B$ imply that $\mathcal B$ is one half of a twin building (equivalently, that the codistance extends to a twinning)?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/20](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1965), page 40. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Classification of $(d,4)$-nets
record.statement: Conjecture. The only $(d,4)$-net is the Hesse arrangement of 12 lines.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/26](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1971), page 12. Canonicalized from 3 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Regularity of fibers of general projections
record.statement: Work over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero. Let $X\subset \mathbf P^r$ be a smooth projective variety of dimension $n$, and let $\pi:X\to\mathbf P^{n+c}$ be a general projection, with $c\ge 1$. Is it true that, for every $y\in\mathbf P^{n+c}$, $\operatorname{reg}(\pi^{-1}(y))\le \frac{n}{c}+1$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/26](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1971), page 17. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Equality with the normalization of the reduced coarse moduli space
record.statement: Is $M_{1,n}(m)=\widetilde{M}_{1,n}(m)$ for all $m$, where $\widetilde{M}_{1,n}(m)$ is the normalization of the reduced space $M_{1,n}(m)$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/26](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1971), page 26. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Short Presentation Conjecture for Finite Groups
record.statement: Every finite group $G$ has a presentation whose length is $O\bigl((\log |G|)^3\bigr)$; the report states that this bound is best possible.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/28](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1973), page 6. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Cohomology-dimension bounds for absolutely irreducible modules
record.statement: For each integer $j>0$, there is a constant $C_j$ such that, for every finite group $G$, every field $k$, and every absolutely irreducible $kG$-module $M$, $$\dim H^j(G,M) \le C_j(\dim M)^{j-1}.$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/28](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1973), page 8. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Ore's conjecture
record.statement: Every element of every finite nonabelian simple group is a commutator.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/28](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1973), page 14. Canonicalized from 4 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: The fake degree conjecture for algebra groups at odd primes
record.statement: Let $p$ be an odd prime and let $P=1+A$ be a finite algebra group, equipped with its classical Cayley map and associated co-adjoint orbit set $\mathcal O$. Then the fake degree conjecture holds: for every $k\ge 0$, \[\{\chi\in\operatorname{Irr}(P):\chi(1)=p^k\}=\{\Omega\in\mathcal O:|\Omega|=p^{2k}\}.\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/28](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1973), page 23. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Euler-characteristic target enumeration
record.statement:
Given a finite collection of tame target supports $\{U_\alpha\}\subset X$ with uniform Euler characteristic $\chi(U_\alpha)=N\ne 0$ for every $\alpha$, and counting function $h:X\to\mathbb{N}$, the number of targets is
\[
\#\alpha=\frac{1}{N}\int_X h\,d\chi.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/29](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2040), page 18. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: De Giorgi’s conjecture for the Allen–Cahn equation in dimensions up to eight
record.statement:
For dimensions $N\le 8$, let $u$ be a bounded solution of
$$
\Delta u+(1-u^2)u=0\quad\text{in }\mathbb{R}^N,
$$
with $\partial_{x_N}u>0$ in $\mathbb{R}^N$. Is it true that, for every $\lambda$, the level set $\{x\in\mathbb{R}^N:u(x)=\lambda\}$ is a hyperplane?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/31](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2042), page 10. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Existence of minimizing Willmore surfaces of prescribed genus
record.statement:
For every $q\in\mathbb{N}_0$, there exists a smooth Willmore embedding $f:\Sigma\to\mathbb{R}^n$ with $\operatorname{genus}(\Sigma)=q$ and $W(f)=\beta_q$, where
\[
\beta_q=\inf\{W(f)\mid f:\Sigma\to\mathbb{R}^n\text{ smooth, closed immersion, }\operatorname{genus}(\Sigma)=q\}.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/31](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2042), page 37. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Almost-everywhere convergence of bilinear ergodic averages for two arbitrary commuting transformations
record.statement:
Let $(X,\text{probability space})$ be a probability space, let $S$ and $T$ be commuting but otherwise arbitrary measure-preserving transformations of $X$, and let $f,g$ be bounded measurable functions. Is it true that, for almost every $x\in X$, the averages

$$\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N} f(T^n x)g(S^n x)$$

record.title: Conjectured optimal weight range for Bergman projections over light-cone tubes
record.statement:
Let $T=\mathbb{R}^{d+1}+i\Omega$ be the tube domain over the open light-cone, with Lorentz form $Q(y)=y_0^2-|y'|^2$. The weighted Bergman projections $P_\gamma$ are conjectured to be bounded on $L^p\bigl(T^{d+1},Q(y)^\gamma\,dx\,dy\bigr)$ for every $\gamma>-1$ throughout the range
\[
1+\frac{d-1}{2(\gamma+d+1)}<p<1+\frac{2(\gamma+d+1)}{d-1}.
\]

record.title: Prime entries in determinant-two matrices
record.statement:
Is the set of $2\times 2$ matrices with determinant $2$ and all four entries prime infinite? Equivalently, is
$$\{A=(a_{ij})\in M_2(\mathbb Z): \det A=2,\ a_{11},a_{12},a_{21},a_{22}\text{ are prime}\}\
$$
infinite?
